name: Shoulder Pain & Disability Index
description: 13-item self-report of shoulder pain and disability. Two subscales: Pain (5 items) and Disability (8 items). Higher score = more pain/disability.
copyright: Free to use (originally published open access)
shirleySays: ICC 0.66–0.95. MDC: 18–20 pts. MCID: 8–13.2 pts. Validated in rotator cuff pathology, shoulder impingement, adhesive capsulitis, shoulder instability, post-surgical shoulder.
